notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Patch 1.0.3 is here!

This time it's a hotfix for Pallet Pressure mode. All levels in this mode will now count dropped pallets correctly!

Thank you for your continuous support!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Patch 1.0.2 is here!

Below you will find list of bug fixes and improvements based on players feedback:

Main Menu:
- Various bug fixes both visual and functional,

In-Game fixes:
- Many visual corrections on the levels (removing redundant non colliding objects),
- Level 6 and Level 20 balance tweaks for hard and extreme difficulty,
- "Mono" forklift physics stability update (it will be less wiggly now),
- Balanced delivery spots precision for all difficulty levels (now it's a bit more forgiving),
- Achievements - "All Star" achievement should now be properly detected when finishing all main game (not DLC) levels with 3-star rating).

Other:
- Localization bug fixes.

Thank you for your continuous support!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Patch 1.0.1 is here! Below you will find list of bug fixes and improvements (based on community feedback).

Main Menu:
- Added "Ambient Sounds" setting to the game options,
- Added "FPS Limit" setting to the game options,
- Holding down dpad/stick or arrows now properly scroll all menus,

In-Game fixes:
- Corrected deadzones for gamepad right stick for better fork moving precision,
- Rotating camera when in top down view now properly rotates camera without changing to isometric view.
- Forks camera improvements - Now you can toggle between 3 stages - No camera / Small camera / Big camera.
- Pallet pressure next round button remapped both for keyboard and controller,
- Corrected physics of soil pallets on level 20+.

Thank you for your support!
